subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should OpenClaw solve WhatsApp conversation-specific debounce through WhatsApp-owned `groups`/`direct` configuration in this PR, or through the generic plugin debounce hook proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both branches address the same remaining user problem but establish materially different long-term configuration and extension contracts; source-level review cannot decide which product boundary maintainers want to support.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded WhatsApp config
options.body: Adopt this channel-owned `debounceMs` contract after real-account proof verifies its documented precedence and batching behavior.

options.title: Choose the generic plugin contract
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458 and narrow or close this PR so only one supported debounce-policy surface remains.

options.title: Defer both contracts
options.body: Keep the existing channel-level debounce behavior until maintainers want to own the support and compatibility scope of either proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded WhatsApp config
recommendation.body: Adopt this channel-owned `debounceMs` contract after real-account proof verifies its documented precedence and batching behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available contributor connected to both proposed implementation shapes; a current-main feature-history owner should be added during maintainer review.
